scope: Controlled research PoC; empirical claims apply to listed observations, not universal security guarantees.

claims.evidence: E2/E3 denial, E4 allowed fixture and denied outside scope
claims.limitation: Observed operations in fixed profiles; no universal filesystem exploit claim.

claims.evidence: E5 allowed demo variable and restricted unrelated environment
claims.limitation: Names/access observations do not expose credential values.

claims.evidence: E3 completes while retaining native permission observation
claims.limitation: Access/check event is not itself an allow/deny verdict.

claims.evidence: Live create/start inspection user=deno
claims.limitation: Verified configured user; no privilege-escalation exploit campaign.

claims.evidence: Live ReadonlyRootfs=true; writable tmpfs explicitly bounded
claims.limitation: Not every possible write primitive was challenged.

claims.evidence: Live Memory=MemorySwap=268435456 bytes
claims.limitation: No new Phase 5 memory-pressure benchmark.

claims.evidence: Live PidsLimit=64
claims.limitation: No new fork/PID exhaustion attack.

claims.evidence: Live CapDrop=[ALL]
claims.limitation: Configuration evidence, not a kernel isolation proof.

claims.evidence: Live SecurityOpt=no-new-privileges:true
claims.limitation: No exploit-based escalation test.

claims.evidence: E6 infinite work terminated, slot released and container destroyed
claims.limitation: 10s configured job deadline; bounded cleanup also has overhead.

claims.evidence: E7 bounded return and outputTruncated=true
claims.limitation: 1 MiB limit can remove audit frame; uncertainty reported.

claims.claim: Global admission bound within one runner
claims.evidence: Two active jobs, third HTTP 429, recovery succeeds
claims.limitation: Process-wide capacity=2, not a distributed/multi-runner global queue.

claims.evidence: Valid host-chat E8 accepted; invalid credential during outage rejected
claims.limitation: Only chat.broadcast is sandbox-accessible; bounded local PoC.

claims.evidence: Capability port lacks admin route; admin/API transport denied to host-chat sandbox
claims.limitation: Deno transport scope plus separate authenticated admin surface.

claims.evidence: Completed command and server_broadcast event
claims.limitation: Server-side confirmation; no connected human-player screen verification.

claims.evidence: DB origin and execution/trace/call IDs; forged mapping rejected even by authenticated harness
claims.limitation: Trusts runner, gateway, API, DB and authenticated plugin; not hostile administrators.

claims.evidence: E6 timeout and E7 truncation yield unavailable, not complete
claims.limitation: Complete means frame collection succeeded, not exhaustive security observability.

claims.evidence: Collector receives E1/E8 spans with matching IDs
claims.limitation: Custom API exporter, detailed debug output only; no full Paper distributed span.

claims.evidence: One collector outage retains denial, authorization, Paper effect and DB evidence
claims.limitation: Export error visible; outage trace not guaranteed to be replayed later.

claims.evidence: 15/15 development, 9/10 holdout, 24/25 combined
claims.limitation: Controlled reference agreement, not general malware-detection accuracy. HOL-008 unchanged.

claims.evidence: 23/25 unanimous across five repeats, 16/25 modal reference agreement
claims.limitation: Saved pinned-model experiment; no Phase 5 live-provider availability test.

claims.evidence: 9/10 frozen workloads compatible across matched experiment
claims.limitation: Native WSL Linux/runsc experiment; not normal Desktop application deployment.

claims.evidence: Recomputed stored duration stats from 100 measured runs; CPU median ratio 1.620, IO 2.615
claims.limitation: Workload/end-to-end WSL measurements, not portable runtime-only overhead.

claims.evidence: W8 runsc DNS fails 5/5; matched runc Paper-confirmed 5/5
claims.limitation: Negative result retained; DNS fix not attempted.

claims.evidence: No escape exploit evaluation performed
claims.limitation: Cannot claim escape prevention from runtime selection, attestation or compatibility.

claims.evidence: Injected throw/stall returns failed analysis with null classification, independent execution outcome
claims.limitation: Focused local regression; active deterministic analyzer not disrupted.

claims.evidence: Strict request validator and only runner receives engine socket
claims.limitation: Trusted runner/engine remain high privilege.

claims.evidence: Docker unavailable path returns 503 and unavailable audit; provider selection explicit
claims.limitation: Not an engine-outage experiment in Phase 5.

claims.evidence: Trusted runner session create/revoke, TTL and call budget
claims.limitation: In-memory session state; no distributed session service.

claims.evidence: Independent generated credentials and fresh volumes; three executions including confirmed Paper effect
claims.limitation: Current uncommitted working tree and cached/network dependencies; not published-HEAD clean clone.

claims.evidence: Not implemented/tested as production multi-tenant service
claims.limitation: Local research PoC with service credentials; production authentication is out of scope.

claims.evidence: No DB-outage experiment in Phase 5
claims.limitation: Healthy durable writes and migrations observed, not high availability.

claims.evidence: Docker integration secret-environment test passes; native observations retain names, not values
claims.limitation: Scope is configured application credentials, not arbitrary future integrations.
